name: Fruit and vegetable seller
blurb: Udhar to customers, dues to suppliers
intro: If you sell fruit or vegetables and give some customers udhar, or buy from suppliers on credit, BolCash helps you keep both records.

uses.title: Customer udhar
uses.body: Note down what each customer owes you for the day's sale.

uses.title: Supplier dues
uses.body: Keep track of what you owe your suppliers, and note it when you pay.

uses.title: Daily cash
uses.body: Record the money that comes in and goes out each day.
